title: Correct final volume
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be expressed as V = p₀V₀/(p - p₀).

title: Boyle's law application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Boyle's law to the isothermal transfer of gas from the cylinder to the bottle.

title: Qualification determination
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must state that the bottle is unqualified (or that leakage > 1%).

title: Leakage calculation
description: Important: The solution must calculate the fractional volume change or mass loss, correctly using the ideal gas law with the given temperature and pressure changes.

title: Constant temperature assumption
description: Important: The reasoning for part (1) must note that the process is isothermal due to the bottle's conductivity and constant ambient temperature.

title: Interpretation of gas state
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly relate the volume ratio V/V₁ to the mass ratio of gas remaining, using the ideal gas law.

title: Sign or algebra error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly solving the Boyle's law equation (e.g., inverting the pressure difference) for the bottle volume.

title: Leakage rate misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Confusing the volume/mass fraction remaining with the fraction leaked, or incorrectly comparing the calculated percentage to the 1% threshold.
